purpose: Qualify a cancellation-resistant mapping from representable effective saturation S in the frozen material domain directly to the uniform log-head table coordinate u, without reconstructing h first and without a hidden head epsilon.

motivation.observed_issue: The algebraic h(S) inverse contains the subtraction S^(-1/m)-1. Near the wet boundary this is poorly conditioned in binary64 and can reconstruct an h a few ulps outside the head envelope even when S is exactly inside the frozen state domain.
motivation.invalidated_interpretation: An interior representable S must not be declared physically out of domain solely because the cancellation-prone h(S) implementation rounds outside the corresponding head boundary.
motivation.relationship_to_c1r_v3: C1R V3 may be used as implementation shakeout but may not be promoted until this state-coordinate gate is resolved.

candidate_mapping.domain_rule: S outside [S_min,S_max] is rejected exactly. No general state or head tolerance extends the physical domain.
candidate_mapping.interior_rule: For representable S strictly inside [S_min,S_max], compute u directly in binary64. The result may equal an endpoint after rounding but must remain finite and inside the closed coordinate interval [0,4].

catalog_scope.constitutive_family: unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten using KSATFIT with KSATEXM disabled

decision_rule: PASS only if every one of the 36 materials satisfies every frozen criterion. Any failure is fail-closed and blocks use of the candidate mapping in C1R qualification.
scope_guard: This gate qualifies only numerical state-to-table-coordinate mapping for the frozen C1/C1R constitutive scope. It does not qualify table interpolation accuracy, KSATEXM, saturation switching, heterogeneous profiles, transient timesteps, process physics, groundwater coupling, MultiSWAP or FullRichards equivalence.
